valuation_template_rationale: Coinbase combines cyclical transaction, stablecoin, custody, subscription, financing and crypto-asset economics, so no specialized repository template fits without a segment and balance-sheet bridge.
rating_change_conditions: Complete a Q2-based segment and balance-sheet valuation in the dependent full review using transaction volumes and take rates, stablecoin economics, recurring revenue, custody and customer obligations, crypto assets, borrowings, cash classification and diluted shares; upgrade only if fresh evidence supports scenario-complete return and margin-of-safety gates, and downgrade the thesis if cycle resilience, counterparty economics, custody controls or dilution-adjusted cash generation deteriorates.
